pipeline: Editable transcription → MIDI → MIDI parser → timing JSON → offline sampler at exact PCM sample boundaries → fixed gain and 16-bit PCM WAV.
renderer: Apple AVAudioUnitSampler, offline at 48 kHz stereo
requirements: Rendering uses macOS AVFoundation and the installed Apple sound bank; Python builder and validator use only the standard library. ffmpeg converts float PCM to delivery PCM without resampling or timing changes.
timing: JSON onsetSample/durationSamples are exact renderer events. Acoustic sample attack/decay is not an instantaneous gate. WAV includes 2500 ms of decay after the 48500 ms score.
